event_summary: Two hands arrange six reflective optical discs into a rough circular ring on a tabletop.
raw_event_description: An overhead view shows a light tabletop with a reflective disc near the upper center and tools at the upper right. A left hand holds or touches the disc, then both hands bring in and separate additional reflective discs. The hands move discs into upper, side, and lower positions, gradually forming a ring-like layout with an open center. Near the end, both hands make small adjustments to the two lower discs and then move away, leaving six discs arranged on the table.

reasons: The scene is dark in the first frame.
One hand and one reflective disc are visible.
Some later-used discs are not yet visible.
Tools at the upper right are visible but partly dim.
